def: properly, to roil water; figuratively, to disturb or affict

words.word: and thou art one of them that trouble
unto him art thou he that troubleth

occurrences.text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the Lord shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the Lord, and I cannot go back.
words: and thou art one of them that trouble

occurrences.text: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
words: unto him Art thou he that troubleth

occurrences.text: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.
And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
